# Simulation Truth

- Eight synthetic founder haplotypes, one chromosome (`chr10`), a
  chromosome-specific recombination map, NAM family labels, ancestry tracts,
  and breakpoints.
- A declared focal gene/marker, six additional polygenic markers, irrigated
  and drought environments, and an explicit focal genotype-by-drought effect.
- Bulk RNA-seq baseline, batch, condition, cis/trans-eQTL, and GxE truth from
  the same simulated NAM genotypes.

# Required Results

- VCF, FASTA, family metadata, ancestry, breakpoints, and recombination map.
- Irrigated/drought phenotype table, QTL truth, drought GWAS and benchmark
  tables, RNA-seq counts/eQTL truth, selected parents, and crossing plan.

# Required Figures

- Environment-specific phenotype distribution.
- Drought GWAS with focal and polygenic truth highlighted.
- RNA-seq PCA colored by condition.
- Genomic-selection candidate versus selected-parent distributions.

# Pass Criteria

- All core result files and the four-panel figure exist.
- Number of NAM lines, phenotype rows, and selected parents equal requested
  values.
- The focal locus is retained in truth and GWAS input.
- The demonstration is labeled synthetic unless a user supplies a compatible
  maize GFF3 and founder panel.
